name: project-lsp
description: Go, Python, Rust and TypeScript code intelligence for Claude Code (go to definition, find references, symbols, hover, diagnostics) that runs one language server per project, so files of other repositories and git worktrees resolve their own imports. Each server starts in its project through mise, with that project's tool versions and virtualenv, and TypeScript 7 projects get the server TypeScript 7 ships.

com.nexaedge.marketplace.tagline: One language server per project, worktrees included
